params.name: id
params.description: transaction id

params.name: acquirer_merchant_id
params.description: The Code identifying the card acceptor as issued by the Acquiring Institution. This may not be unique across institutions. Also referred to as the MID. ISO8583 - DE 42. This field is for the MID used between VF and a 3rd party acquirer or processor.

params.name: amount
params.description: Amount of the transaction.

params.name: created_at
params.description: The time at which the transaction was created.

params.name: created_start
params.description: The start time range for when the transaction was created, specified in UTC. Use this in conjunction with `created_end` to query for a time range. A maximum range of 1 month of transactions can be queried at a time. Note: If this is not specified it will default to the current date/time - 7 days.

params.name: created_end
params.description: The end time range for when a transaction was created, specified in UTC. Use this in conjunction with `created_start` to query for a time range. A maximum range of 1 month of transactions can be queried at a time. Note: If this is not specified it will default to the current date/time.

params.name: country_code
params.description: The country code resolved from the customer's ip address.

params.name: currency_code
params.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 alphabetical currency code. e.g. USD.

params.name: customer
params.description: The ID of a customer.

params.name: enity_id
params.description: The identifier of merchant entity you want to process the transaciton is already processed.

params.name: invoice_number
params.description: The invoice number used to track the order for POS transactions. For Ecommerce, use merchant_reference.

params.name: payment_product_type
params.description: Fees applied to the transaction, based on the payment product. e.g. For card transactions - interchange fees

params.name: shopper_interaction
params.description: Determines the point of sale of a customer.

params.name: _sort
params.description: Sorts the results by ascending order according to the provided field. If the field is prefixed with dash (e.g. -created_at), the order is descending.

params.name: _skip
params.description: Skips a number of pages.

params.name: reason_code
params.description: A reason code assigned by the acquiring platform; '00' in case of success.

params.name: rrn
params.description: Retrieval Reference Number, is a transaction identifying reference number that is designated by the card acceptor system.

params.name: pos_device_id
params.description: Identifier of the POS device used for the transaction.

params.name: stan
params.description: System Trace Audit Number.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the transaction
